nom: Earth Therapeutics Hydrogel Collagen Under Eye Patch

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry under-eyes describe the patches as hydrating, plumping, and soothing, with one calling them well suited to anyone with dry under-eye skin.
segments.sensitive: Two reviewers specifically note sensitive skin or eyes and report no irritation, burning, or stickiness problems despite the adhesive gel.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal skin found the gel dry-ish and not particularly hydrating, giving only 3 stars.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 40s to 60s report reduced puffiness, brighter under-eyes and a temporary softening of fine lines, though several middle-aged users say the effect on true aging signs (deep lines, sagging) is modest or absent.

concerns.aging: Many mature reviewers report smoothed fine lines and a temporarily tighter, more rested look; several middle-aged or older users state the patches help with fine lines but do little for deeper wrinkles, sagging, or true collagen loss.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say their under-eye area feels hydrated, plump, and smooth right after removal; one reviewer with normal skin found the gel dry-ish and not hydrating at all.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports her dark spots lightened with use, but this is an isolated observation.

aspects.libelle: Sticks too firmly, pulls delicate skin

extraits.titre: Good under-eye patch, especially for the young
extraits.texte: I have used at least five, 5-patch boxes of the Earth Therapeutics Collagen Hydrogel Under-Eye Patch, purchased both online and in an Ulta store. I am middle aged, and well into declining facial collagen. I look like I care well for my skin for my age, but pore size, very fine lines, and skin elasticity is not what it used to be. These patches are good for refreshing tired eyes, moisturizing, and slightly plumping the under-eye area. As a result, I notice a temporary smoothing of the finest of my fine lines. I think for the price point, I might purchase them again to at least get some results when on a budget. My preference is to pay a little more for under-eye patches with a little more effectiveness for older eyes. I imagine they would be very effective for the needs of people in their twenties and thirties, for refreshing and moisturizing tired eyes, perhaps after a late night. I did not find them to be particularly effective for middle-aged tired eyes and puffiness.

extraits.titre: not impressed, would not buy again
extraits.texte: I'm 33, with normal skin. I bought these to wear before makeup, to see if it would help my concealer application during my cycle when my under eyes get super dry. I put these in the refrigerator and the cold gel under my eyes was soothing but only because they are cold. The eye gels are dry-ish. they are not suspended in a serum like other eye gels. these do not leave my eyes feeling hydrated and supple. the cold effect is gone after a few minutes and they dont do much after removed. i give 3 stars because they didnt irritate or burn. I bought the patchology instead to try next.

Earth Therapeutics is my favorite brand in Ulta for full sheet masks. So, when I saw these for the under eye area, I had to try them. I've been on the hunt for nice under eye patches at a fair price for awhile. These have not disappointed! They are good for anyone with DRY under eyes, or lacking sleep often. After the first use, I didn't notice a change in shade, but it minimized the tired appearance I woke up with. It leaves the under eye area plump, cool, and smooth after removal. The patches are very sticky and stay on the face well. You can walk around without these sliding off. As I wear them I notice a cooling sensation that's very relaxing. If you have dry under eyes and wish to pamper yourself, I recommend these hydrogel patches!

extraits.titre: Triple Threat: Eye Serum, Eye Cream & an ET Eye Mask
extraits.texte: I am a 48 y/o WOC fighting with dark circles. Now more like a dark intermittent line. I am using eye serum, eye cream and now eye masks 2x day in am and pm routines. I use this after skin care regimen completed and while doing eye prep and shadow. At night apply before bed after night regimen for 30 minutes to 1 hour. Eye area looks better, less dark and fading, concealer doesn't crack, can go without concealer, and I look younger and better rested. I have prestige eye masks for special occasions but I use these from ET daily. Like chewing gum, I always have extra. I don't look like a Walking Dead zombie around the eyes anymore or a rabid raccoon with dehydration. It takes work, effort, and time to do this consistently but this is a war with aging and the eyes are but one battle:) No breakouts from Triple Threat method as my skin is mature. Cost is reasonable and I have slapped one of ET eye masks on after a workout cleansing, on an airplane, etc. I keep these in the fridge and apply my eye masks cool and adding to the pampering. If you struggle with lines, circles, bags, wrinkles other eye stuff try it!

I was hesitant to try these. But I love them. They are soft and I love that they don't leave product after you take them off. I think they help with my puffiness and a little bit with dark circles if I'm tired. I'll keep buying these. I have sensitive skin and was worried about the stickiness...but I haven't had ANY problems. Great product and great price.

Came back from vacation on the fly and had my 60th Birthday party to attend. You know how it goes. Spectacular product! Depuffed removed lines and brightened my eyes! Will buy again. Also I have extremely sensitive eyes...no problems!

The only positive thing I can say about this product is that the patches created a nice cooling sensation under my eyes for the 30 minutes I was wearing them. Unfortunately, the patches not only failed to diminish my under eye bags, but they increased the size. Immediately after peeling off the patches, my eyes were more puffy than before the treatment. Nice, just what I wanted, additional baggage!
